text:
Elena (Events): Quick sync — Redwood x OakCloud partner summit session (hybrid track). Panel + live hardware demo. Need speaker confirmations, a dry-run time, backup demo plan, and swag pickup location. 30m run-through Thursday 9:00am PT works for folks?
Leah (Partnerships): Works for me. Nina from OakCloud is joining — @Nina can you confirm who will speak from your side and whether the HW needs any special staging?
Marco (Sales): Heads-up: we'll need two people at the booth during the session for lead capture. I can cover the first half, can someone cover the 2:30–4:00pm slot?
Nina (OakCloud): Confirmed: Sara (product lead) + Ben (systems) will present. HW kit arrives stage left. Important: OakCloud devkit needs 220V and NTP sync. Can we get onsite power + a table with 2ft clearance? Also, if anything goes wrong we prefer a recorded remote demo fallback.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a fallback script and a trimmed pre-recorded demo (4 min). Fallback steps:
- Switch output to recorded stream
- Share deck + recorded playback
- Run a simplified API call from laptop (curl example) to show results
Example curl snippet for fallback:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v2-3q","input":"Summarize this handshake sequence"}'
```
Tom (Eng): Technical checklist for live demo:
- Pin model to rwd-v2-3q for deterministic outputs
- Warm KV cache with 100 concurrent short requests 10 min before demo
- Whitelist conference wifi egress for api.redwood.ai IP ranges
- Bring ethernet dongle — conference WiFi is flaky
I'll be at the dry-run to validate latency and token counts.
Elena (Events): Swag plan: single pickup table by entrance. Inventory to bring from office: 80 tee shirts (various sizes), 300 stickers, 100 acrylic standees. Customs note: hardware will need commercial invoice, @Leah can you confirm export paperwork?
Leah (Partnerships): On it — I'll DM shipping docs. Also uploading slides and speaker bios to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/partners/summit (final deck v2 by Wed EOD). Please add any speaker headshots there.
Nina (OakCloud): Shipping update: tracker #OC-987654321 — ETA Wed 10:30am local. We'll send two onsite engineers to help with setup (Ben + Sam).
Marco (Sales): For booth staffing I'll cover 10:00–12:00. @Priya can you and Tom cover 2:00–4:00pm? That leaves 12–2 open.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can do 2:00–3:00. Tom can take 3:00–4:00 if that's ok.
Tom (Eng): Yep I can do 3:00–4:00. I'll also bring a spare GPU laptop and a USB ethernet adapter.
Elena (Events): AV run-of-show: 15:00 stage mic check, 15:15 HDMI + laptop test, 15:25 rehearsal with remote presenter, 15:40 final cue. Dry-run Thurs 9:00am PT (Zoom link in calendar invite). Please be on time.
DeployBot: Reminder scheduled: AV rehearsal calendar invite sent to participants (Thu 09:00 PT). Link expires after event.
Leah (Partnerships): Action items summary:
- Leah: export paperwork + slide upload (Wed EOD)
- Priya: pre-recorded fallback + curl script (Tue EOD)
- Tom: whitelist IPs + KV warmup script + bring ethernet (Thu morning)
- Nina/OakCloud: shipping confirmation + onsite engineers (Wed morning)
- Elena: swag table + AV schedule + run-of-show
We'll reconfirm at dry-run. Anything else?
